settings.heading: He wrote the book on training trainers
settings.body:
Chris Hitchko has been teaching trainers since 2008. He watched talented people pass their textbook exams, walk onto a gym floor, and wash out within a year — not because they didn’t know anatomy, but because nobody taught them how to actually do the job.

Show Up Fitness is the school he built to fix that.
